# Example Docs

> Documentation for the Example client libraries.

## Getting started

Install the Python client:

```bash
pip install requests
```

Or the Node client:

```bash
npm install chalk
```

## Reference

- [API guide](https://docs.example.com/guide)
- [Changelog](https://docs.example.com/changelog)
- [PyPI project page](https://pypi.org/project/requests/)

All packages are published from the official registries. No configuration
of alternate indexes is required.
